svg.aria-label: HomeSweet. Rental and real-estate platform for Phnom Penh, built with a five-member team where I'm project manager. Property search with an interactive map; Rental applications and digital lease agreements; ABA KHQR payments with PDF receipts; Real-time chat and roommate matching; 360-degree virtual tours; Camera-based identity verification. Built with Vue, Firebase, Vercel.
